snippet.title: SPOOKY TALES: NINI'S TEDDY | Official Trailer (Psychological Horror Game)
snippet.description:
SPOOKY TALES: NINI'S TEDDY | Official Trailer (Psychological Horror Game)


📱 Pre-register on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.BlackBrainStudios.SpookyTales

🎮 Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4906290/Spooky_Tales_Ninis_Teddy/


Itch.io : https://blackbrainstudios.itch.io/spooky-tales

👻 Tell me which scene scared you the most!

Some secrets should never be found.

Step inside a haunted house where every shadow hides a mystery, every room tells a story, and a forgotten teddy bear may be your only clue... or your greatest curse.

Spooky Tales: Nini's Teddy  is a story-driven first-person horror game featuring atmospheric exploration, puzzles, supernatural encounters, and psychological horror.

## 🎮 Coming Soon

🖥️ Steam (PC)
📱 Google Play (Android)

⭐ Wishlist on Steam
📲 Pre-register on Google Play

If you enjoy horror games like Outlast, Visage, MADiSON, or Layers of Fear, you'll feel right at home... until Nini finds you.

💬 Let us know:
Would you enter the house... or run away?

👍 Like the trailer
💬 Leave your thoughts in the comments
🔔 Subscribe for gameplay, development updates, and future chapters.
